title: Splash Water Balloon Daily Mission and Summer Shop
original_title: [Event] Splash! Water Balloon Collection Daily Mission Event & Summer Shop
author: Grendel
summary: The June 11-July 22 Water Balloon daily mission event awarded summer currencies and opened a Summer Shop through July 24 for players past Chapter 1-4.

sections.title: Daily missions
items: Daily missions reset at midnight server time.
Missions include defeating monsters, summoning Elite Monsters, and playing Ruler of the Beach.

notes: Structured summary verified against the official Nexon Forum event notice on 2026-07-27.
event_name: Splash Water Balloon Daily Mission and Summer Shop
requirements: Complete the listed daily missions and optional Ruler of the Beach objectives.
rewards: Growth materials from the Summer Shop
participation_steps: Spend Summer Coins before the shop closes.
